name: Multicultural Fair
description: A beloved tradition at this school, we once again invite you to share your culture with us, whether it's helping with your country's booth (or starting one if it isn't represented yet!), fashion show, or with a group cultural performance. Due to time constraints, solo and duo performances are encouraged to perform at the Los Alamitos Variety Show on March 20th.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) from 12:45pm - 2:00pm during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!!

name: Castillero Athletic Booster Club
description: Attention 5th grade parents! Looking to get involved at Castillero? Consider joining the Castillero Athletic Booster Club (CABC) Board! The time commitment is very manageable and it is a great way to get involved at Castillero!

name: Castillero Music Booster Club Fundraiser
description: Support Our CMBC Program – Sweeten Easter & Mother's Day! We've partnered with See's Candies once again to bring you delicious, high-quality chocolates just in time for Easter and Mother's Day. All sales from this storefront will support instruments, sheet music, and performance opportunities for our students—and we'd love your support!
